sourceText:
Green Bean Casserole
By: Melissa Peterman
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




2 box of frozen green beans, thawed and drained
1 can Durkee French Onions
1 can Campbell's Cream of Mushroom Soup
3/4 cup Milk
1/4 teaspoon Black pepper

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. 2 Combine the milk and the cream of mushroom soup into a 2-qt. casserole dish. Stir this with a fork until smooth. Add black pepper, green beans, and 1/2 the can of French onions and stir into soup mixture. 3 Bake casserole at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until bubbling. 4 Remove from oven, sprinkle remaining onions evenly on top, and return to oven for another 5-10 minutes or until the onions are a golden brown.

About


NOTE: You can use nonfat milk instead of whole milk and the recipe will still work great! Prep time: 15 min. Cook time: 40 min.
